description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 3 came out on 26 September 2025 with Gengar on its cover. It gathers Pokémon that come out at night, such as Clefable, which plays on lonely lakes under the full moon, Meowth, whose eyes shine in the dark as it prowls its territory, and Gengar, which slips into people's shadows. As in the earlier volumes, every card is a holo, four to a pack.

Its 18 Pokémon come in the same range of finishes as before, among them patterns of their Energy type, a Master Ball pattern and a gold-foil Gem Pack logo, and some come as holo Pokémon ex. Nine art illustration cards include Meowth on a rooftop watching lights drift across the moonlit sky, Gengar using its moves on snacks in an empty living room, Cubone, Chandelure and Ceruledge. It also has holo Super Rod, Nest Ball, Switch and Arven cards, basic Fighting and Metal Energy and Luminous Energy. The cards are numbered with four digits, the first two for the Pokémon, from 01 for Clefable to 18 for Annihilape (19 for Trainers and 20 for Energy), and the last two for the version.
